instructions.example: Click here to view an example of a predefined archetype.
instructions.modal: In this diagram, the 'Person' object is initially defined as it is the focal point (in pink) for data collection. Various attributes pertaining to the person, such as 'Demographic' data and 'Lifestyle' data, are mapped out as distinct categories. These categories can then contain more sub-categories such as ethnicity or directly connect to real variables from your database.
